explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/978, first question: under the stated hypotheses, does {n : f(n) is (k-1)-power-free} have positive density? Hooley [Ho67] settled this with an asymptotic. The extra hypothesis that no p^{k-1} is a fixed divisor is automatic here: f is primitive, and k is not a power of 2. So it is harmless. HasPosDensity means that a positive natural density exists. Faithful.
